disposition_reason: Table 1 prints mean ± SD cadmium, lead, zinc, copper, chromium and calcium (ppm) in fresh cow milk from dairy farms at two West Sumatra locations.

study.design: Farm milk survey at two locations
study.origin: dairy farms in Lubuk Minturun (Padang City) and Padang Panjang City, West Sumatra, Indonesia
study.method: HNO3:HClO4 (4:1) digestion of 5 mL or g; AAS with 10-50 ppm calibration standards
study.qa: Acid-washed ware, reagent-grade chemicals; no CRM, recovery or LOD reported

findings.notes: Printed ND; Table 1 footnote defines ND both as "Not Determined" and as "<LOD"; text says not detected; LOD not printed.

unresolved: Lead 13.58 and 20.58 ppm in fresh milk are implausibly high for milk and the method cannot be checked (no LOD, CRM or recovery; calibration 10-50 ppm).
ND is defined both as not determined and as below LOD; text treats cadmium and chromium as not detected.
